files.theme.colors.css: Imported by ../theme.css. Imports colors-raw/globals.css and all nine palettes; defines the companions (surface, indicator, track), the usage roles for every palette. Family-agnostic: never changes on rebrand.
files.colors-semantic/accent-1.css: Imports indigo; defines --accent-1-1..12, --accent-1-a1..a12 and the --accent-1-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/accent-2.css: Imports violet; defines --accent-2-1..12, --accent-2-a1..a12 and the --accent-2-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/accent-3.css: Imports plum; defines --accent-3-1..12, --accent-3-a1..a12 and the --accent-3-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/accent-4.css: Imports crimson; defines --accent-4-1..12, --accent-4-a1..a12 and the --accent-4-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/neutral.css: Imports slate; defines --neutral-1..12, --neutral-a1..a12 and the --neutral-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/danger.css: Imports red; defines --danger-1..12, --danger-a1..a12 and the --danger-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/warning.css: Imports amber; defines --warning-1..12, --warning-a1..a12 and the --warning-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/success.css: Imports green; defines --success-1..12, --success-a1..a12 and the --success-contrast values.
files.colors-semantic/info.css: Imports blue; defines --info-1..12, --info-a1..a12 and the --info-contrast values.

description: Nowind colour theme: colors-semantic/ maps colour families from colors-raw/ to nine palettes (accent-1, accent-2, accent-3, accent-4, neutral, danger, warning, success, info); theme.colors.css maps those to usage roles. Every value uses light-dark(), so light and dark mode come from color-scheme (colors-raw/globals.css).

accent-1.use: Main brand accent: main actions, links, focus

steps: In colors-semantic/<palette>.css, change the @import and every --colors-<family>-* reference to the new family.

Set --{palette}-contrast from library.solidLabel.families in this manifest: light in both modes → var(--{palette}-contrast-white); dark in both → var(--{palette}-contrast-black); light then dark → light-dark(var(--{palette}-contrast-white), var(--{palette}-contrast-black)).

To add a palette, copy a palette file in colors-semantic/, rename the prefix and family, set its contrast from solidLabel, import it in theme.colors.css, and copy one palette's companion and role block in theme.colors.css with the new name. Then run node scripts/utilities.mjs and node scripts/bundle.mjs.
rebrand.notes: Indigo, violet, plum and crimson take light text on step 9 in both modes, so their -contrast is -contrast-white in light and dark. Slate, red, green and blue take light text in light mode and dark text in dark mode. Amber takes dark text in both.

naming.rule: The bare name is the middle of its group; -weak and -strong move one step within the group (less or more contrast against the page, in both modes). Without a palette name a token uses the neutral scale.

exceptions.note: Borrows step 8 from the border group. Below body-text contrast: hints and disabled labels only.
Not a scale step: the inverse of --{neutral|accent-N}-contrast, darkest text in light mode and lightest in dark.

palette.use: Scale steps of each palette; families are listed under palettes.
Transparent versions of steps 1–12; they match the solid steps over --neutral-1. For overlays and varied surfaces.

tokens.use: Text and icons on --solid-{palette} (neutral: --solid). Built from --{palette}-contrast-white and -black, hand-copied from the library's solved on-solid values; see palettes[].contrast.
Translucent fill for surface variants: cards, soft fields. Radix uses step 2 at 50%.
Subtle areas: sidebars, striped rows, code blocks.
Control borders and the focus ring.
Text and icons on a solid.
Hints, disabled labels. Below body-text contrast.

shadows.moved: Shadows are generated by scripts/shadows.mjs into theme.shadows.css; see theme.shadows.manifest.json.

statuses.rule: Each status has the full accent role set with the status name in place of 'accent-N': --bg-danger, --component-danger-weak, --border-danger, --solid-danger, --on-solid-danger, --fg-danger-weak, plus --danger-surface, --danger-indicator and --danger-track.
statuses.info: Info uses blue rather than the library's cyan.
statuses.warning: Amber takes dark text on its solid in both modes, so --warning-contrast is --warning-contrast-black in light and dark.

accents.rule: Four brand accents replace the old primary. accent-1 is the main one: the reset uses it for links, the focus ring, accent-color, caret and ::selection. Each accent has the full role set: --bg-accent-N, --component-accent-N-weak, --border-accent-N, --solid-accent-N, --on-solid-accent-N, --fg-accent-N-weak, --accent-N-surface …
accents.neutral: Neutral stays slate, the library's pairing for indigo (accent-1).

library.name: radix-hct-colors
library.copiedFrom: radix-hct-colors/tokens/colors (Radix 12-step scales regenerated in HCT, sRGB)
library.note: The library's own manifest.json is not copied; the one fact from it Nowind needs, each family's solidLabel, is recorded below.

solidLabel.meaning: The text colour on step 9 of each family, per mode: light = --{palette}-contrast-white, dark = --{palette}-contrast-black.
